intervals.label: hosting the SoLid project (construction from 2016)
intervals.note: Start is the year the SoLid detector construction began; interval of the particle-physics use only. BR2 is a research reactor of the Belgian Nuclear Research Centre; its own start date was not sourced. The interval is open because no source consulted says the reactor has stopped.
intervals.quote: proceeding to the construction of a 1.6 ton detector in 2016-2017

operator.note: The paper names SCK CEN as the host institute of the BR2 reactor; the operator relationship is inferred from that wording.
operator.quote: SoLid is operated next to the BR2 reactor at SCK CEN in Mol, Belgium.

summary.plain: The Belgian Nuclear Research Centre at Mol, whose BR2 research reactor burns highly enriched uranium in a compact core; the SoLid experiment placed an antineutrino detector next to it from 2018 to 2020.
summary.technical: SCK CEN (Belgian Nuclear Research Centre), Mol, Belgium: BR2 is an open-pool research reactor burning highly enriched uranium (93.5 % 235U) at 40-100 MW_th with a compact (about 50 cm x 80 cm) core; host of the SoLid antineutrino detector at 6.3-8.9 m.
